# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: Support for Overdue Todo Items

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the requirements for the overdue-todos feature before implementation (author self-review).
**Created**: 2026-08-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are well-written — NOT whether the implementation works.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for every combination of completion status and due-date position (past/today/future/absent)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements specified for how an invalid or unparseable due-date value affects overdue state? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements documented for the behavior when a todo object itself is missing or malformed? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the visual indicator's required elements (icon, accessible name, color styling) all captured as requirements rather than only in the contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the empty-list and single-item cases so the feature's scope boundary is explicit? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the recompute trigger set (load, user interaction) fully enumerated so no update path is left unspecified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "current date" unambiguously defined (local calendar date, time-of-day ignored)? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "earlier than the current date" precise about comparing calendar days rather than timestamps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "visually distinguish" quantified with concrete, measurable presentation criteria rather than a subjective term? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "immediately" (reflect changes immediately) defined against an observable point in time such as the next render? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the descriptive `aria-label` text specified or bounded, or left open to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "at a glance" translated into a measurable expectation (e.g., identification time) rather than left qualitative? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the FR-002 (due today = not overdue) and the edge-case narrative consistent about the "full day to complete" rationale? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the requirements, data-model derivation rules, and UI contract behavior table agree on all eight input rows? [Consistency, Contract §Utility]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the acceptance scenarios in User Story 1 & 2 consistent with the functional requirements they map to? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §US2]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "no background timer" statement consistent everywhere it appears (spec, clarifications, data model)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK017 Are color-token references (`--danger-color` / `--color-accent`) consistent with the design system named in requirements? [Consistency, Contract §Component]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-001 ("under 5 seconds") be objectively measured with a defined method and conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Is SC-002's 100%/0% coverage claim backed by an enumerated set of cases it must hold for? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-004's "accessibility contrast" expectation tied to a specific, verifiable standard (e.g., WCAG AA)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Are success criteria each traceable to at least one functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001–SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Does each acceptance scenario have a clear Given/When/Then that is independently testable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1, §US2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the primary flow (viewing a mixed list and identifying overdue items)? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the state-transition flows (complete→not overdue, incomplete→overdue)? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the alternate flow where the due date is edited to/from a past date? [Coverage, Data Model §State transitions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the calendar-advances-while-open scenario, including when the indicator must appear? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are recovery/undo scenarios (e.g., re-opening a completed overdue item) addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §US2 #3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Is the boundary of "due exactly today" explicitly specified as NOT overdue? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the "no due date" case explicitly specified as never overdue? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the "completed regardless of due date" case explicitly specified as never overdue? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for timezone-boundary situations given "current date" is local? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for a `completed` field expressed as `0/1` vs boolean, so truthiness is unambiguous? [Edge Case, Data Model §Todo]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Are accessibility requirements (non-color-dependency, screen-reader announcement) specified for the overdue indicator? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK034 Are light/dark theme contrast expectations captured as requirements rather than only in the contract? [Gap, Contract §Component]
- [ ] CHK035 Are performance expectations for recomputing overdue state on each render addressed or explicitly deemed out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the requirement that the derivation be a pure, side-effect-free computation captured where it belongs? [Consistency, Contract §Utility Guarantees]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that the existing data model already includes an optional due date and completion status validated? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that overdue is derived (not persisted) documented and its implication (stays correct as calendar advances) stated? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Are out-of-scope items (sorting, filtering, notifications, new persisted fields) explicitly excluded to prevent scope creep? [Boundary, Spec Assumptions, Contract §Non-goals]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the dependency on existing design tokens for accent/danger color documented as a prerequisite? [Dependency, Contract §Component]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK041 Is there any conflict between "reflect changes immediately" (FR-007) and "no background timer re-evaluates at midnight"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK042 Is the icon choice (e.g., "⚠" / "warning icon") specified as a requirement or left as a non-binding example? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK043 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme established and applied consistently across artifacts? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Each item validates the REQUIREMENTS themselves (completeness/clarity/consistency/measurability/coverage), not the implementation.
- Traceability references point to `spec.md` sections, the UI contract, or the data model; `[Gap]` marks a suspected missing requirement.
